name: prevue
description: Opens Jetpack Compose @Previews in the browser without Android Studio, and lets your agent read the spot you point at on screen as a file and line.

interface.shortDescription: See Compose Previews without Android Studio and point at the screen
interface.longDescription: Renders Jetpack Compose @Previews with headless layoutlib and opens them in the browser. Saving redraws them in about a second, and your agent reads the node you click in a Preview as a file and line.
defaultPrompt: Show the Previews for this Compose screen
